hero.badge: Dukan sabis · App ɗaya · Damar da ba ta ƙarewa
headlines: Ma'auni ɗaya don duk abin da kake buƙata.
Biya kuɗaɗe, tura kuɗi, kuma yi ciniki da katunan kyauta.
Yi ajiyar jiragen sama, otel da mota a duniya.
Sami ƙwararrun ma'aikata don aikinka na gaba.
hero.subtitle: Kiredit, data, DStv, wutar lantarki — da kuma kasuwa, ma'aikata kusa da kai, katunan kyauta, turawa da tafiye-tafiye. Duka daga jaka ɗaya.
hero.download: Sauke app na OAM a Google Play da App Store — kuma ka sami duniya a hannunka.
